session_note: Mississippi holds annual (non-carryover) regular sessions; each year's bills are independent and any bill not passed by that year's sine die adjournment is dead and must be reintroduced in a later year. The 2026 Regular Session convened in January 2026; floor action on the two enacted bills below concluded with conference-report adoption on 2026-03-31, enrolled-bill signing on 2026-04-02/04-06, and gubernatorial approval on 2026-04-08, consistent with the Legislature's normal early-April sine die timeframe for an even-year (non-budget-only) session; an independent adjournment-resolution date was not separately fetched in this pass.
